mechanism_narrative: PARKS is the only series with an unbroken four-week improvement (-80.3 to -75.4), a steady outdoor-normalization signal that precedes broader discretionary mobility; continued weekly PARKS gains pull RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose 4.9 points from t-3w (-80.3) to t-0w (-75.4)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's mean over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its last-28-day mean of -52.05 while PARKS continues to improve week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES fell 6.2 points over three weeks to -46.6, the sharpest deterioration in the snapshot, marking deeper work-from-home under active restrictions; the loss of commuter daytime footfall removes demand from street-level and mall retail, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean falls below -45.0 percent change from baseline (a week-on-week drop greater than 4.0 points)
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -40.4 at t-3w to -46.6 at t-0w, with the largest drop (-4.0) in the final week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's mean over the next 14 days exceeds -50.2 after WORKPLACES closes a week below -45.0.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL holds at or above +13 while WORKPLACES falls in two consecutive weeks, households sit in a self-reinforcing stay-at-home cluster; out-of-home shopping trips are cut faster than the stay-at-home margin lifts neighborhood spend, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean >= 13.0 and WORKPLACES declining in two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL weekly means were 16.3, 15.3, 13.7, 15.6; WORKPLACES fell in t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL >= 13.0 and WORKPLACES fell twice consecutively, the next-14-day RETAIL_REC mean is higher than the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM reversed from -18.0 to -23.3, its weakest reading in four weeks, showing eroding willingness to make routine out-of-home errands; discretionary trips fall first, so RETAIL_REC drops within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM week-on-week change <= -3.0 points (observed at t-0w: -19.7 to -23.3)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell 3.6 points week-on-week to -23.3, below its t-3w level of -22.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's week-ahead mean rises above -50.3 following a GROCERY_PHARM week-on-week drop of 3.0 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC climbed from -55.4 to -50.3 while PARKS improved in every week; a break above the -50.0 line marks intact recovery momentum rather than a plateau, and that momentum carries RETAIL_REC higher over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly mean rises above -50.0 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 5.3 points from t-3w to t-1w and held at -50.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the two weeks after RETAIL_REC closes above -50.0, its mean fails to exceed -50.3.

mechanism_narrative: Late-August heat and typhoon season in Hong Kong caps outdoor and street-level activity even as restrictions ease; with PARKS still about 75 points below baseline, seasonal suppression keeps RETAIL_REC flat to lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS remains at -75.4, roughly 75 points below baseline, in the late-August seasonal window
failure_condition: The next-14-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last-14-day mean of -50.2 during the late-August seasonal window.

mechanism_narrative: In the mobility-normalization regime defined by three or more consecutive weeks of PARKS improvement, RETAIL_REC lags PARKS and then converges upward; the observed PARKS run from t-3w to t-0w therefore predicts a higher RETAIL_REC mean over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves for a third consecutive week (t-0w PARKS >= -75.4)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved in each of t-2w, t-1w and t-0w while RETAIL_REC stalled at -50.3
regime_hint: mobility normalization: three or more consecutive weeks of PARKS improvement
failure_condition: Conditional on a 3+ week PARKS improvement run, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not above the last-28-day mean of -52.05.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS improving while TRANSIT declines week-on-week (t-0w: PARKS +0.7 points, TRANSIT -1.1 points) signals substitution of leisure trips toward outdoor space and away from indoor commercial destinations, dragging RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves week-on-week while TRANSIT declines week-on-week by more than 1.0 point
evidence_refs: fact:at t-0w PARKS improved 0.7 points while TRANSIT fell 1.1 points, a 1.8-point divergence
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS rises and TRANSIT falls simultaneously, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last-28-day mean.
